people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
translations.bsb: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
translations.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
translations.asv: They took up stones therefore to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple.
